version.description: Protocol version implemented by the service, `<major>.<minor>`. Clients do not use a service whose major version is not 1.

id.description: Service id. For a local plugin it MUST equal the manifest `id` (whose syntax `manifest.json` constrains); a self-hosted service has no manifest and may use any non-empty id. The official service is `cuelor`.

capabilities.description: What the service implements. A missing boolean means false; a missing `generation` means no generation.

generation.description: Output modalities the service can generate.

webhook.description: Optional webhooks (v1.md section 3.5.6). Not used by the Cuelor app.

status.description: `ready`: usable. `needs_setup`: no upstream key or login yet. `invalid_credentials`: the upstream rejected the current key.

label.description: Human-readable account description. MUST NOT contain the full key.
